sources.name: actions-e
sources.annotationMethod: Each X is the independently interpreted projected pelvic center of that native pose, excluding the pack, blanket, pouch and weapon. Each Y is the exclusive lower edge of alpha>=64 pixels in the nearer visibly supporting boot sole. X is a manual illustration registration, not a physical anatomy measurement. Inspect both complete leg-to-boot chains in each native cell, select a narrow sole-only ROI on the nearer weight-bearing boot, and compute maxYExclusive at alpha>=64. The farther boot is higher in the oblique projection and does not replace the nearer sole. Gun butt, shadow and sheet bounds are excluded. Subtract the independently selected cap-crown alpha>=64 minimum Y from the supporting-sole ground Y in each cell. Use the six-span median 348.5, rounded half upward to one source-wide referenceHeight of 349. No phase-specific size normalization is permitted. The reviewer selected six cap-crown-only rectangles and six narrow supporting-sole rectangles by inspecting the complete native sheet and each cell. Temporary in-memory cell views and neutral-field composites clarified alpha and anatomy; no diagnostic raster was saved and no source or exported pixel was changed. ROIs were recomputed against the exact copied candidate SHA-256. The fire cell was inspected at native resolution and with a temporary nearest-neighbor pixel enlargement. [394,161] marks the visible end of the upper dark barrel before the thinner projecting bayonet; the reviewed point has native alpha 113. The bounded ROI includes the barrel-end metal. This is a visual effects anchor, not a certified physical barrel aperture.

sourceSpecificPostureAllowance.basis: The two aimed poses are 341/340 pixels; upright ready/cartridge are 354/360; charge and raised ram are 352/345. The spread follows the illustrated posture pattern and the complete sheet shows no obvious torso/limb family scale substitution. Cap-to-sole extent is pose-sensitive, so this narrow exception is defensible for an opt-in illustration pilot. It does not relax older sources or certify anatomy.

limitations: This is a genuinely separate model-assisted source inspection, not human art, anatomy, historical or usability certification.
The original 5% cap-to-sole gate failed: 20/348.5 = 5.738880918220947%. Acceptance uses the explicit source-specific 6% amendment only.
Manual pelvis centers and ROI selection are interpreted from a painted illustration; they are not physical joint or bone measurements.

All six broad action roles and complete visible leg chains are readable, but concealed fingers, true weapon internals, bayonet continuity, intermediate ramrod handling and full historical drill chronology remain unverified.
Fire and final aim are static shouldered poses. Firing, recoil, shot emission and time continuity require renderer evidence.

The full cap-to-sole range is about 1.84 pixels at a 32-pixel reference height and 2.73 pixels at 58 times 0.82 before camera zoom. This is a calculated extent difference, not a measured animation-jitter result.
Very faint alpha values reach some cell edges. Solid alpha padding passes, but complete edge/fringe freedom is not certified.
This approval covers exactly this complete unresampled native source and does not approve default art, the remaining identities/bearings, melee, casualties or the whole game.

Charging and ramming poses omit or obscure the projecting bayonet visible in ready/cartridge/aim. This source does not establish bayonet, lock, barrel, ramrod or paper-cartridge continuity across a complete historical drill.

All exported PNG bytes remain native and unchanged, including very faint alpha>=1 pixels at some cell edges. No alpha cleanup, cross-cell repair, phase interpolation, raster resizing, warping or per-phase body normalization is applied.

Only the four-phase reload definition carries nativeReloadSequence gettysburg-v18-confederate-a-e; ready and fire remain single-pose definitions. Action timing, turning, pause/cold-resume, shot anchoring, field memory and human usability remain separate checks.
sources.scope: Exact native Gettysburg v18 local opt-in Confederate A east stationary illustration pilot only; default, production, complete family, human, physical anatomy and historical drill approval remain false.
